## Project identity
**Descriptive name:** **Documented Hugging Face Story-Generation Fine-Tuning Pipeline**

A pair of long Markdown notebook-style guides for story-generation fine-tuning. They specify Hugging Face dataset loading, EDA, readability/vocabulary analysis, preprocessing, GPT-2 tokenization, causal-language-model collation, Trainer configuration, evaluation and generation. The second guide explicitly pivots from BookCorpus to alternatives such as TinyStories because of dataset availability/copyright constraints. The code is technically substantial as a documented pipeline, but the final repository does not preserve an executed notebook, model weights, logs or metrics, so successful training must not be inferred.
